name: manas
description: The company's mind — versioned, source-cited memory on Google ADK. A Gemini Mind-Keeper routes ingestion; four Gemini imbibers fan out across disjoint modalities (documents, images, founder voice, the world's pulse) in parallel; a Claude-via-Vertex Memory Curator verifies every claim cites a source and is non-contradictory before commit (a deterministic groundedness loop, v14 -> v15); a Claude-via-Vertex Founder Voice answers as the founder grounded only in corpus and refuses out-of-corpus. manas knows; it never acts, posts, or decides.

skills.name: Get founder context
skills.description: Return the versioned, source-cited Context Pack (cited facts + voice rules + brand rules) for a topic — the grounding the rest of the company is bound by. An out-of-corpus topic returns an honestly ungrounded pack (grounded=false, no facts), never a fabricated one.

skills.name: Ask the founder's voice
skills.description: Answer a question AS the founder, grounded ONLY in the imbibed corpus, with citations. If the question is out-of-corpus it REFUSES (refused=true, empty citations) rather than fabricate a founder opinion — the guardrail that keeps the company from being bound by a hallucinated answer.
examples: Do we grandfather existing subscribers when we change pricing?

skills.name: Remember the day's decision
skills.description: Drive the ingestion -> curate -> commit pipeline to remember an outcome: route ingestion (Mind Keeper), imbibe the four modalities in parallel, verify every claim cites a source and is non-contradictory (Claude Curator verify-before-commit loop), and tick the Context Pack v14 -> v15. Refuses to commit (rollback) an under-grounded or contradictory memory. No human gate — manas knows, it does not ask approval to remember.
examples: Remember today's decision: Raise Pro to $34, grandfather existing, 30-day notice.

notes: Served manually by the FastAPI server rather than via ADK's to_a2a() helper: to_a2a() is currently blocked by the a2a-sdk 1.1.0 restructure (a2a.server.apps was moved, breaking the import path ADK expects). Until ADK pins/adapts to the new a2a-sdk layout, the server reads this static AgentCard and exposes it on the well-known discovery path itself, and answers JSON-RPC manually. The get_founder_context / ask_founder_voice A2A skills are synchronous and pure-corpus-backed (they never drive the async pipeline), and are grounded in the same corpus the agents use, so the A2A surface and the agents can never disagree.
